Legal Specialist Tech & Data (m/f/d)
Overview

NEON is a highly specialized business law firm providing advice at the highest level. We embrace shared entrepreneurship, are more than just colleagues, and love what we do. Our teams – including Venture Capital, Private Equity, Litigation, Real Estate, Tax, and Tech & Data – deliver holistic advice and work closely together.
 Our focus is on the legal support of entrepreneurial projects – from investments and transactions to the development of new business models, the structuring of complex commercial arrangements, and the legal enablement of digital innovation.
Our Tech & Data Team advises national and international clients on legal issues relating to data protection, IT law, AI, digital business models and the regulatory requirements of an increasingly digital economy. We help innovative companies navigate complex legal frameworks and enable technological progress through practical legal advice.
Are you looking for a position that allows you to pursue your legal career ambitions while benefiting from predictable working hours and more time for your personal life? 

We offer a great alternative.

To join our team, we are looking for a


Your mission

You are passionate about the intersection of law andtechnology and want to deepen your legal expertise in these areas.  
As a Legal Specialist in our Tech & Data team, you will work on a broad range of matters relating to data protection, IT law, artificial intelligence and digital business models and take ownership of legal tasks to actively contribute to the successful delivery of our client matters. Working closely with a highly specialized team, you will gain insight into some of the most dynamic developments at the intersection of law, technology and business. 
Unlike a traditional Associate role, your focus will not be on transactions. Instead, you will take ownership of clearly defined areas of responsibility and recurring legal matters that allow for a predictable and manageable workload while still offering work on champions league level.


What we offer

  • Flexible working time models (Full-time or Part-time, with adjustable weekly working days), clearly defined working hours to help you plan your life and ensure a steady, predictable workload 
  • Independent but clearly scoped areas of responsibility 
  • Involvement in client work from day one, supported by your team lead
  • A respectful and vibrant company culture (team-lunches, after-work events, many firm activities…)
  • A healthy balance between work, family, and personal life


Your profile

  • You have successfully completed both German State Examinations in Law (at least 18 points in total)
  • A genuine interest in Tech & Data – including data protection, IT and software law – ideally with first practical experience in these fields
  • Curiosity for technology (AI, software contracts, cloud computing, and digital business models) and enthusiasm for solving legal challenges around digital innovation
  • You have a quick mind, can think outside the box and enjoy working in a team
  • Excellent German and strong English skills complete your profile

Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)

The ILF Solar Photovoltaic & hybrid systems team works across a vast range of large-scale renewables projects and programs, both grid connected and off-grid across private and public sectors globally. We offer you to join a dynamic environment and to work on unique and exciting projects (including floating PV, complex hybrid systems, combination with Hydrogen, rural electrification, etc.).

Join our Team in Munich or Fontainebleau / Paris to contribute to the transition toward a decarbonized and sustainable energy future!
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Photovoltaic & Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), (M/F/D)

jobs.title: Minijob: Digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Minijob: Digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis – digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen – und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.

Eine steuerfachliche Vorbildung brauchst du dafür nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung

  • Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten.

  • Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst.

  • Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate.

2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann

  • Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir.

  • Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger.

Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher.

3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten

  • Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist. Das läuft asynchron, also unabhängig davon, wann du arbeitest.

  • Du verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht, und erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht.

4. Du machst die KI besser

  • Du meldest wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder: Was passiert, wie oft, was sollte stattdessen passieren. Deine Hinweise gehen direkt an Engineering und Design – mit Rückmeldung, was daraus geworden ist.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt.

  • Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster.

  • Verbindlichkeit statt Dauererreichbarkeit: Was du zusagst, ist im vereinbarten Zeitraum erledigt. Wann du es erledigst, entscheidest du.

  • Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software einzuarbeiten.

  • Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz und stabiles Internet für deine Arbeitsblöcke.

Nice-to-have

  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

  • Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung – auch wenn sie Jahre zurückliegt.

  • Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools: Prompts, Formeln, Filter, einfache Automatisierungen.

Was wir nicht erwarten: steuerfachliche Vorbildung, Kanzleierfahrung oder Programmierkenntnisse.

Was wir bieten

🕒 Freie Zeiteinteilung, wirklich. Keine Kernarbeitszeit.

🤍 Realistische Planung. Kind krank, Kita zu, Ferien: Wir puffern das ein, statt so zu tun, als gäbe es das nicht. Sag Bescheid, wir schichten um.

🚀 Deine Verbesserungsvorschläge werden gebaut – nicht abgeheftet. Unser Anspruch: Ein klar beschriebener, umsetzbarer Vorschlag ist innerhalb von acht Arbeitsstunden live.

🤖 Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was Automatisierung in der Steuerberatung kann – Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen, Hardware wird gestellt.

📈 Aufstockung jederzeit möglich – auf Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, wenn deine Situation es zulässt. Der Weg zur Spezialist:in für digitale Belegprüfung steht dir offen.

🏡 Vollständig remote. Büro in München im Herzen der Stadt, wenn du willst – Pflicht ist es nicht.

🎓 Echte Einarbeitung. Strukturiertes Onboarding und eine feste Ansprechperson – auch bei kleinem Stundenumfang.

Working Student System Administration (all genders)
YOUR IMPACT - YOUR ROLE

Show us how you rock IT!

You juggle bits and bytes while others are still looking for their coffee cups? Then join our dynamic and modern company, where innovation and agility are lived. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills further and be part of an international team.

For this, we are looking for you as our Working Student System Administration (all genders).

Your mission in detail:

  • As our Working Student System Administration, you are the contact person for all hardware and software problems and support the Helpling team with questions regarding the IT infrastructure in our Berlin office.

  • You support the provisioning and maintenance of our Windows- and OSX-based environment and help provide your colleagues with high-speed, bugless equipment.

  • You help manage our local networks and support troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation.

  • You bring your own ideas to improve existing workflows through customized automation.

  • You help ward off cyber attacks, create backups, and contribute to our overall IT security.


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

A vocational training or degree is not the most important thing to us. We value your experience and are therefore looking for practically-versed, plug-and-play heroes with versatile IT knowledge who are currently enrolled at a university.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, migration history, marital status, age, or disability.

People Operations Lead - 3 month FTC
jobs.description:
People Operations Lead - 3 month FTC

📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home

📅 Initial 3 month FTC - potential option for extension or perm.

⏰ 40 hour week ideally although 30-32 hours considered.

🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.


✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!


About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This is a slightly unusual brief, because we're looking for a very particular combination of experience.

First and foremost, you need to be an experienced, hands-on People Operations person. But you also need to have previously worked as an accountant, or have substantial professional accountancy experience.

And we mean accountancy specifically. Experience partnering with Finance, managing a People budget or processing payroll isn't the same thing.

Why such a specific combination? Because we've seen first-hand just how well it can work.

We've seen the value that a professional accountancy background can bring when combined with strong People Operations experience - financial discipline, an instinct for controls and data, and an analytical approach to understanding how systems and processes work. We're now deliberately looking for that combination again.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's genuinely curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll inherit a strong foundation. Over the last three years we've streamlined manual processes, invested in our People technology and changed the way our People function operates. There's plenty we're proud of - but we're definitely not done!

You'll own our People operations, systems and data infrastructure across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle, making sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for opportunities to simplify, automate and improve them.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting. You'll work closely with our People Partners, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech teams, so this is a highly collaborative role with influence across Goodlord.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and agentic workflows can remove repetitive work across areas such as onboarding, colleague queries, document management, data validation and reporting. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be excited about the possibilities, willing to experiment and comfortable helping us work out where technology can genuinely make things better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You'll want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

What does that mean in practice?

  • You're naturally curious and analytical. You ask good questions, get underneath problems and use data rather than instinct alone to make decisions.

  • You love improving how things work. You've reviewed, redesigned and implemented processes rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and a confident collaborator. You can turn an idea into something that actually works and bring people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Previous professional experience working as an accountant or in a substantive accountancy role. This is essential for this particular hire.

  • Significant People Operations experience, with evidence that you've owned and designed end-to-end People processes, not simply operated processes someone else created.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data using a modern tech stack, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're of course open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems, alongside strong analytical and advanced Excel skills.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including ownership of pay review cycles, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement - spotting friction, getting underneath the root cause and leading meaningful changes that have made processes simpler, better or more scalable.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate. You'll be comfortable experimenting with new tools and ways of working.

  • You'll be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech to solve problems and make change happen.

It would also be great if you have

  • Experience working in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

And one thing you won't need

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

A little more about the contract

This is initially a three-month fixed-term contract. We're continuing to think about the longer-term shape of our People team, so there is the potential for the role to become permanent if there's a strong mutual fit and an ongoing need.

We're also open to part-time working for the right person. Finding the right combination of People Operations and professional accountancy experience matters more to us than insisting on a particular working pattern.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

jobs.title: Head of Technical Support
jobs.description:
Head of Technical Support

📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP

 

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

  • Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

  • Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

  • Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

  • Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

  • Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

  • Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

  • Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

  • Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.

  • A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.

  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.

  • Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.

  • Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.

  • Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.

  • Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work.

Experience that would be useful

  • Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.

  • Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.

  • Leading support across different time zones.

  • Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation.

  • Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.

What success looks like

During your first six months:

  • Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.

  • Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.

  • You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas.

  • Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers.

  • Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling.

  • Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows.

Why Join Duffel?

We’re a growth-focused team that values open communication, diverse perspectives, and true ownership. We want you to feel empowered in your role, which is why every permanent employee becomes a company shareholder.

 

🌍 Live Your Best Life

  • Duffel Travel Allowance: We subsidise your wanderlust.

  • Work From Anywhere (60 days): Your office, your rules.

  • Sabbaticals: Long-term loyalty, long-term breaks.

  • Flexible Bank Holidays: Swap holidays to suit your schedule.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system.

This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.

  • Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.

  • Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.

  • Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.

  • Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems.

  • Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors.

  • Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware.

  • Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces.

  • Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.

  • Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing.

  • Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers

  • Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning.



What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems.

  • Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development.

  • Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers.

  • Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills.

  • Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications.

  • Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP.

  • Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces.

  • Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems.

  • Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging.

  • Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies.

  • Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

Support Operations Analyst

Job title: Support Operations Analyst

Reporting to: Support Lead

Location: Remote (UK based)

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI?

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. Aveni harnesses the power of voice to drive unprecedented efficiency and oversight. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

  • Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

  • Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

  • Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

  • Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

  • AI Support Optimisation – Take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI customer support experience. At Aveni we use Intercom Fin, but experience with Zendesk AI or similar platforms is equally relevant. Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. Own regular reporting on AI involvement, resolution and deflection rates, using the data to identify trends, prioritise experiments and demonstrate the impact of changes.

  • Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. Identify documentation gaps through conversation reviews, support trends and AI performance, and work with Product, Marketing and Training & Enablement to close them.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong interest in technology, SaaS, and AI.

  • Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with confidence owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution or escalation.

  • Hands-on experience optimising AI customer support platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI or similar. We’re looking for evidence that you have actively improved how an AI agent performs — for example by authoring and testing content, tuning workflows or routing, reviewing conversations for deflection opportunities, and using involvement, resolution or deflection reporting to drive measurable improvements. Direct Fin experience isn't essential; the track record matters more than the platform.

  • Experience maintaining customer-facing knowledge bases or Help Centres and turning support trends into clear, useful documentation.

  • A collaborative team player who is comfortable working both remotely and independently.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a B2B SaaS or fintech environment, particularly supporting complex or regulated customers.

  • Experience designing or running experiments to improve AI agents, automation or self-service journeys in a customer support environment.

  • Experience using support and AI metrics such as SLA, CSAT, involvement, resolution and escalation trends to identify and prioritise improvements.

  • Experience with incident and problem management practices, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering during high-priority incidents and managing lower-impact bugs through a backlog or sprint-based development process.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities

  • 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Share options – we believe in shared success

  • Skills development – continuous learning is at our core, expect the development to be front and centre of everything you do

  • Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both

  • Life insurance, income protection and private health care

  • Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers

  • Emotional wellbeing (Employee assistance programme provides access to 24/7 employee counselling and emotional support)

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%)

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to drive positive change and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. We know that some people are likely to only apply where they meet 100% of requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists.

We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen.

This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond.

You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. If you want to define what a demand gen career looks like in the agentic era, this is the seat to do it from.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams.
  • Work across channels, not in one. Support and strengthen programs across paid, email, events, web, and outbound as team priorities shift. You'll be the person who can step into any channel and make the program better.
  • Build agentic workflows. Use AI tools (Claude Code, agents, internal AI infrastructure) to automate program execution — audience building, content generation, signal detection, campaign QA — and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project.
  • Connect programs to the sales motion. Translate marketing signals into actions sellers actually take: account coverage, buying signals, campaign follow-up. Partner directly with sales leadership on what's working.
  • Measure what matters. Instrument your programs, report on pipeline impact honestly, and kill what isn't working.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source / developer-focused a plus).
  • Proven range: you've run programs in at least two or three channels (email/lifecycle, paid, events, web, outbound) and can point to pipeline results in each.
  • Experience marketing to existing customers — expansion, cross-sell, or customer lifecycle programs — not just net-new acquisition.
  • Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.
  • Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.
  • Strong program management fundamentals — you ship on time, communicate proactively, and work well with sales, product marketing, and ops without needing a coordinator.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with PLG or product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.
  • Familiarity with the observability / monitoring / open source ecosystem.
  • You've worked in Marketo, Salesforce, and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).
  • You've written or shipped something public about AI in marketing operations.

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is CAD 101,000 - CAD 122,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)

Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

    • Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity.

    • Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments.

    • Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness.

    • Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions.

  • Be a Senior Technical Leader

    • Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level.

    • Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers.

    • Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in a relevant field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or comparable).

  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, ideally with several years in autonomous trucking.

  • Outstanding technical depth across the full autonomous driving system: autonomy software (perception, planning, control, end to end planner architectures), autonomy hardware (compute, sensors, user interfaces), base vehicle hardware architecture, and system integration.

  • Proven experience delivering complex systems in regulated environments; defense background is a strong plus but not mandatory.

  • Outstanding technical project and program management skills: roadmapping, critical path management, risk management, and delivery steering of multi-team workstreams.

  • Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs.

  • Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team.

  • Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d)
Wir suchen dich!

Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten Sales Development (m/w/d), der uns dabei unterstützt, noch mehr Unternehmen für bessere Kundenkommunikation zu begeistern.

Jeden Tag helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten. Damit noch mehr Unternehmen von unseren Lösungen profitieren können, möchten wir unseren Kundenstamm gezielt erweitern und neue Kontakte aufbauen.

Du hast Freude daran, dich in Unternehmen einzulesen, die richtigen Ansprechpartner zu identifizieren und den ersten Kontakt herzustellen? Du bist neugierig, kommunizierst gerne und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Ruhe bringen? Dann passt du zu uns.

Vorerfahrungen im Vertrieb sind dabei kein Muss. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du Interesse an Menschen, Unternehmen und guter Kommunikation mitbringst. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team. Nach deiner Einarbeitung kannst du überwiegend remote arbeiten. Für Trainings, Feedbackgespräche, Teamtage oder andere wichtige Termine freuen wir uns, wenn du nach Absprache an einem unserer Standorte dabei bist.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du recherchierst Unternehmen, die zu unseren Zielkunden passen.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Ansprechpartner und pflegst Informationen in unserem CRM.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache potenzieller Kunden per E-Mail, Telefon und LinkedIn.
  • Du führst erste Gespräche mit Interessenten und prüfst gemeinsam mit dem Team, ob ein passender Bedarf besteht.
  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam.
  • Du dokumentierst Aktivitäten und Erkenntnisse sauber in unseren Systemen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ansprachesequenzen weiter und testest, welche Ansätze gut funktionieren.
  • Du gibst Rückmeldungen aus Gesprächen und Recherchen an Vertrieb und Marketing weiter. 


Deine Rolle bei uns

  • Du bist kein Praktikant im Hintergrund, sondern Teil unseres Vertriebsteams.
  • Du lernst, wie moderne Neukundengewinnung im B2B-Umfeld funktioniert, übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung und arbeitest eng mit unseren Vertriebskollegen zusammen.
  • Wenn du langfristig im Vertrieb arbeiten möchtest, kannst du dich bei uns perspektivisch in Richtung Sales Development Representative oder Account Executive weiterentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Must-haves

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben.
  • Du kommunizierst gerne mit anderen Menschen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du bist neugierig und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein.
  • Du hast keine Scheu davor, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Nice-to-haves
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, Service, Vertrieb, Recruiting oder einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit.
  • Interesse an Vertrieb, Software, Digitalisierung oder Kundenservice.
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit LinkedIn, CRM-Systemen oder anderen digitalen Tools.
  • Interesse daran, langfristig Erfahrungen im B2B-Vertrieb zu sammeln.


Warum wir?

Die „Basics“: 30 Tage Urlaub, hybrides Arbeiten möglich, ein fester Feierabend, ein Budget für deine Weiterentwicklung, Team-Events, JobRad, Altersvorsorge und eine Spendit-Card sind einige der Angebote, die unsere comdesk´ler zu schätzen wissen
Arbeit mit Sinn: Mit deiner Arbeit hast du einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Unsere Lösungen sind immer einen Herzschlag voraus und setzen neue Standards im Kundenservice. So leistest du mit deiner Arbeit einen echten Mehrwert und trägst dazu bei, dass Service Hotlines ihrem Namen endlich wieder alle Ehre machen
Teamwork: Was wir an der comdesk besonders lieben? Unsere Kollegen (w/m/d)! Wir halten einander den Rücken frei, nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst und können uns immer aufeinander verlassen. Bei uns ist Team Work keine hohle Phrase!
Gemeinsam wachsen: Dein Wissen ist unser aller Gewinn. Deshalb spielen wir dir regelmäßig Updates auf, in Form von Konferenzen, Workshops, Kursen, Trainings, neuester Technik – was immer du brauchst, um dich beruflich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln
Kein Lari-Fari: Was du tust, vergammelt nicht in einer Schublade, sondern kommt zum Einsatz. Auf unnötige Bürokratie und stundenlange Meetings haben wir keine Lust. Wir arbeiten fokussiert, hands-on und mit einem Blick fürs Wesentliche
 
Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung als Werkstudent Sales Development (m/w/d) bei comdesk! Du hast noch Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei uns.

Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois

🚀 Rejoignez une institution d’excellence et d’innovation en tant qu’Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de recherche en intelligence artificielle appliquée à la vision industrielle 3D, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, innovation technologique et transfert vers l’industrie,   affecté(e) au Centre Fayol de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

Au sein de ce centre de recherche pluridisciplinaire (plus de 80 personnes), reconnu pour son expertise en IA, systèmes cyber-physiques et sciences des données, vous contribuerez à des projets de R&D à fort impact pour l’industrie du futur. Le centre s’appuie notamment sur sa plateformes technologiques IT'M Factory et est un acteur-clé de l'enseignement et de l'innovation au sein de l’Institut Mines-Télécom.

 

Dans le cadre du projet régional DIGIMAN3D, financé par la Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, ce recrutement vise à développer et expérimenter une solution de contrôle dimensionnel 3D en ligne, basée sur l’acquisition de données 3D et l’intelligence artificielle, pour le contrôle automatisé de pièces mécaniques de précision en conditions industrielles.

 

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

· Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure.

· Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles.

· Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm.

jobs.description:
Human Design Program Lead (f/m/d)

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. 

To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. 

This role sits within the Human Design Team. 

Purpose of the Human Design Lead

The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. Human Design activities align to Global Practices and include:

  • Human enablement

  • Behavioural transformation

  • Leadership Development Programs

  • Coaching

  • Learning

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • New and existing senior clients’ relationships

    • Responsible for regional client portfolio (expected approx 4 clients)

    • Point of contact for senior client relationships long term

    • C-suite leadership coaching and enablement 

  • Kick-start Human Design discussion with clients

      1. Line of Sight

    • Senior cover for Human Design activities throughout migration including ongoing risk monitoring and escalation

  • Cultural stewardship

    • Embody the Kraken ways of working and support the delivery team to do the same (and ensure a consistent experience across the portfolio)

    • Act as the bridge between new clients and best practice success stories

🧠 What you bring to the party:

  • In depth knowledge and expertise in all facets of Human Design necessary to enable transformation (including cultural transformation, leadership development, coaching, learning) 

  • Experience in leading portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies

  • Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

  • Excellent facilitation skills

  • Experience in navigating ambiguity and complexity 

  • Clear understanding of the connection between human, organisation and technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations 

  • Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable 

  • In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation behavioral best practices including concepts such as 

    • Psychological safety

    • Empowerment 

    • Growth mindset 

    • Agile leadership 

    • High performing team

What we’re looking for

  • A systems thinker who is human-led based in Paris, France 

  • We are a kind, friendly, human organisation.

  • Deep understanding of adult learning, behaviour change and organisational psychology.

  • A world-class and experienced leadership development expert.

  • A storyteller who deeply understands the art of facilitation 

  • Proven credibility working with senior leaders and executives.

  • Experience building or scaling leadership or learning practices in complex environments.

  • Calm, confident and playful presence - able to challenge with empathy and clarity.

As we are an English-speaking company, please provide your CV in English.

jobs.title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
jobs.description:
Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility
