jobs.title: Manager I, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Manager I, Customer Success

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Manager, Customer Success — Scale leads the entire Scale (Mid-Market) segment for Mexico, owning both the high-touch and digital success motions across our Scale Segment. This role is responsible for a team of Customer Success Managers who manage a large, geographically diverse book of mid-market accounts, combining personal engagement with scaled, tech-touch programs to drive adoption, retention, and growth at volume.

In addition to leading a team, this leader will directly own and evolve the Digital Scale journey — designing and operating the automated, data-driven customer experience that serves the long tail of the Mexico Mid-Market portfolio. You will partner closely with Sales, Services, Support, Product, and Marketing to build a repeatable, high-quality success motion that works at scale.

Spanish and English fluency is required. Multilingual capabilities (particularly French) are a strong advantage given the breadth of the North American territory.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of CSMs covering the Mexico (Mid-Market) segment.
  • Set clear expectations, goals, and KPIs (e.g., net revenue retention, adoption rates, health scores, business review completion, risk management).
  • Run structured 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and risk reviews; deliver consistent coaching and developmental feedback.
  • Recognize and grow top talent; address underperformance quickly and fairly.
  • Manage capacity and account assignment across a high-volume book to balance CSM workload and customer coverage.

Digital Scale Program Ownership

  • Own and continuously improve the Digital Scale journey for Mexico. In some case this journey will affect all customers in North America — the automated, tech-touch customer experience for the mid-market segment.
  • Define and execute digital plays (onboarding sequences, adoption campaigns, renewal outreach, health score triggers) in partnership with Marketing and CS Operations.
  • Analyze engagement data to identify gaps, optimize messaging cadence, and improve conversion and retention outcomes at scale.
  • Ensure a seamless transition between digital and human-led touchpoints, maintaining a consistent customer experience across both motions.
  • Stay current with best practices in digital CS and bring innovative ideas to scale the team's impact without sacrificing quality.

Customer Outcomes & Execution

  • Ensure the team drives measurable value for mid-market customers through structured onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal motions.
  • Review and elevate the quality of Customer Success Plans, Business Reviews, and executive-ready materials across the portfolio.
  • Oversee book-of-business risk management — ensure early identification, clear ownership, and documented action plans for at-risk accounts.
  • Support CSMs in high-stakes customer moments (QBRs, escalation calls, executive check-ins) as needed.

Strategy, Process & Enablement

  • Translate company and CS strategy into a clear operating model for the Scale segment — defining cadence, plays, and standards for both high-touch and digital motions.
  • Standardize and improve core processes across the regions (onboarding-to-steady-state handoff, BR cadence, risk playbooks, escalation paths).
  • Use data and tooling (CS platform, CRM, product analytics, digital engagement tools) to monitor performance, surface insights, and guide team decisions.
  • Partner with Enablement to ensure the team has the skills, playbooks, and resources to succeed across a distributed, high-volume territory.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary CS point of contact for Sales, Renewals, Services, and Support leaders for the segment.
  • Partner with Sales on account planning, expansion strategy, and commercial alignment across mid-market accounts.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Operations on recurring customer themes, friction points, and feature gaps specific to the mid-market segment.
  • Represent the Scale customer voice in internal forums and influence roadmap and policy decisions.
  • Coordinate with regional stakeholders across the US, Canada, and Mexico to ensure localized execution where relevant.

Culture & Leadership

  • Model and reinforce the company's cultural principles: customer focus, growth mindset, inclusion, and teamwork.
  • Foster an environment of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate clearly and regularly with senior leadership on progress, risks, headcount, and territory health.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, or a related customer-facing role, with direct ownership of mid-market or enterprise accounts.
  • 3+ years directly managing a team of CSMs or similar roles, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record driving portfolio-level outcomes: renewal, expansion, adoption, and executive engagement.
  • Experience operating in a high-volume, scaled CS environment — managing both tech-touch/digital and high-touch motions simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ownership or hands-on experience building or managing digital customer journeys, automated programs, or tech-touch CS motions.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS or a similarly complex, technology-driven environment.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills; comfortable engaging VP+ stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Data-driven operating style: able to interpret dashboards, define KPIs, set guardrails, and translate insights into action.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust, collaborate cross-functionally, and operate in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) — required for customer engagement and internal collaboration across the regions.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience leading teams that span both pooled/scale and high-touch/enterprise books of business simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Customer Success tooling (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) and CRM systems; experience using these platforms to drive digital programs is a strong plus.
  • Experience building or refining playbooks, metrics frameworks, and digital engagement programs for mid-market CS teams.
  • Background in operations-heavy industries (e.g., transportation, logistics, field services, manufacturing) is a plus.
  • Bilingual or multilingual skills — Spanish and/or French (Canadian) preferred, given the North American territory scope (US, Canada, Mexico).
  • Experience managing or collaborating with teams across multiple North American markets and time zones.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Senior QA Automation Engineer - Product (LATAM)

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. jobs.title: CSM II
jobs.description:
CSM II

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is looking for a Customer Success Manager II to own the health, adoption, retention, and growth of a book of Small Business (SMB) accounts. Reporting to a Manager of Customer Success, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for HR benefits leaders across your portfolio, helping them communicate the value of the Carrot benefit, respond to their needs, and ensure Carrot remains a celebrated part of their benefits offering.

Your day-to-day will center on proactive account management: running regular check-ins and business reviews, monitoring success metrics like CSAT, utilization, and member engagement, and surfacing risks before they become churn drivers. You will support renewals across your book and identify expansion opportunities that contribute to ACV growth. This is an ideal role for a customer-centric CS professional who executes established playbooks with consistency and quality while building the foundation for growth into more complex account work at Carrot.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the health, adoption, retention, and growth of a book of SMB accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for HR benefits leaders
  • Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to align on goals, track program performance, and course-correct proactively
  • Monitor and act on success metrics including CSAT, utilization, and member engagement to identify risks and address churn drivers early
  • Support the renewal cycle across your book, partnering with Customer Success leadership to drive on-time close and strong retention outcomes
  • Identify and pursue expansion and upsell opportunities within your book, contributing to ACV growth
  • Partner with internal teams, including Product, Implementation, Member Support, and Operations, to ensure customers realize full value from their Carrot partnership
  • Maintain accurate account records and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce
  • Execute established SMB playbooks with consistency and surface feedback that helps the team improve and scale

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Built trusted relationships across your SMB book, reflected in strong CSAT scores and retention outcomes
  • Consistently met retention, engagement, and growth targets for your portfolio
  • Established a proactive account management rhythm, with risks surfaced and addressed before they escalate
  • Contributed expansion opportunities that grew ACV across your book
  • Earned a reputation as a reliable, collaborative teammate who operates established playbooks with quality and consistency

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or customer support in a high-growth technology environment
  • A track record of managing a book of business with strong retention and customer satisfaction outcomes
  • Comfort presenting to HR benefits leaders, with a clear, empathetic communication style that balances customer needs against internal priorities
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset
  • Enthusiasm for Carrot’s mission and eagerness to be part of a collaborative, friendly, and dynamic team

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Familiarity with Carrot’s buyers (HR benefits leaders) and the employee benefits landscape
  • Prior experience supporting renewal or expansion conversations with existing customers
  • Experience with tools beyond Salesforce, such as Gong, Airtable, or BI/reporting tools
  • Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-scaling environment; organized, diligent, and self-motivated

Why This Role Matters

SMB customers make up a large share of Carrot’s customer base, and the CSM II role is the front line of how those customers experience Carrot. Strong account management at this level directly protects retention, drives member engagement, and creates the expansion pipeline that fuels segment growth.

Every renewed account and every engaged member means more people accessing fertility and family-building care through their benefits. This role turns Carrot’s mission into a lived experience for thousands of members, one well-managed account at a time.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Presentation Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $70,000.00 $82,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Risk Protection Takedowns
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Digital Risk Protection Takedowns

With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world’s most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

Recorded Future is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own and advance takedown capabilities within our Digital Risk Protection portfolio. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad ownership and visibility across a critical area of the business.

The work sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, product development, automation, external partnerships, and business strategy, with the opportunity to shape how Recorded Future delivers and scales takedown outcomes globally.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Define the vision, priorities, and operating model for takedown capabilities within Digital Risk Protection.
  • Strengthen service delivery: Assess current workflows, performance, escalations, and customer pain points, then drive immediate and sustained improvements.
  • Scale the capability: Prioritize the highest-impact takedown types and translate complex operational requirements into scalable product workflows.
  • Design the operating model: Partner with Engineering and AI teams to improve validation, evidence collection, authorization, submission, monitoring, escalation, verification, and reporting, including where automation or human review is required.
  • Establish safeguards: Work with Legal and external experts to address authorization, false positives, liability, policy requirements, and regional differences.
  • Build the external ecosystem: Develop relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, and other disruption partners to improve speed and success.
  • Measure and grow impact: Establish meaningful performance metrics and partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on packaging, monetization, adoption, retention, and growth.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, direct experience executing, designing, or leading digital takedown services, with meaningful ownership of the takedown lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of how requirements and execution vary by threat type, provider, platform, geography, evidence standard, and legal or policy basis.
  • Experience across relevant use cases such as phishing, malicious sites, domain abuse, impersonation, trademark or copyright infringement, social media abuse, or exposed code and data.
  • Experience turning complex, manual operations into product strategy, requirements, workflows, and scalable technology.
  • Technical fluency with APIs, automation, AI-assisted workflows, integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Strong judgment around customer impact, false positives, liability, and when to involve legal or other subject-matter experts.
  • Demonstrated ability to align Product, Engineering, Legal, Support, and commercial teams without relying on a large dedicated organization.
  • A hands-on, curious, and collaborative approach, with the ability to solve immediate problems while building the longer-term model.
  • Existing relationships with registrars, hosting providers, platforms, or disruption partners are valuable. The ability and willingness to build them is essential.

jobs.description:
Senior Catalog Manager & PIM - Travel & Hospitality Tech

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

Our client is an award-winning, leading strategic digital communications and transformation agency operating at the intersection of enterprise-grade technology and creative delivery. As a critical hub within a premier global digital services and marketing network, they collaborate directly with major regional brands, government entities, and large-scale destination enterprises to architect high-impact digital experiences. They specialize in driving large-scale digital transformation across the hospitality, tourism, travel, and commerce sectors.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Product Catalog & PIM is a highly strategic business owner and subject matter expert responsible for establishing, governing, and optimizing the enterprise product catalog strategy. This role leads the end-to-end evaluation, design, onboarding, and implementation of a centralized Product Information Management (PIM) ecosystem—specifically utilizing tools like Akeneo—and unifies it with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). This position sits at the center of cross-functional alignment, ensuring scalable, consistent, and localized (+8 languages) multi-product data models power everything from mobile apps and booking funnels to complex resort channel systems.

Responsibilities

  • Catalog Strategy & Governance: Define the master enterprise catalog vision, operating model, taxonomy structures, data ownership rules, and lifecycle management workflows across distinct product business lines.

  • PIM Platform Leadership: Act as the primary Product Owner and business lead for the end-to-end evaluation, deployment, and rollout of the enterprise PIM ecosystem.

  • Complex Data Modeling: Architect omnichannel-ready product schemas that map complex variations, hierarchies, and cross-sell structures across accommodations, activities, memberships, mobility, and retail offerings.

  • Enterprise Systems Integration: Drive the integration strategy connecting the PIM with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), resort channel managers, inventory engines, payment platforms, and CRM solutions.

  • Booking & Conversion Enablement: Optimize product discoverability and merchant capabilities by configuring rich metadata, media, and promotional bundles that drive personalization and recommendation engines.

  • Data Quality & Localization: Set corporate data validation benchmarks, track catalog health metrics, and manage multilingual localization layers (+8 languages).

  • Stakeholder Management: Facilitate alignment workshops and coordinate directly between Revenue Management, Commerce, Digital Experience, and external implementation partners.

    • Ecosystem Familiarity: Direct experience working alongside Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Adobe Experience Cloud platforms.

    Nice-to-Have:

    • CRM Systems: Familiarity with enterprise CRM tools such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or Adobe Campaign.

    • Asset & Analytics Tools: Experience interacting with Digital Asset Management (DAM) platforms and modern product analytics software (GA4, Adobe Analytics, Power BI, or Tableau).

    • Certifications: Professional credentials in PIM platforms, data governance frameworks, Salesforce, or Adobe Experience Cloud.

    Engagement & Timezone Details:

    • Location: 100% Remote (LatAm).

    • Timezone Alignment: Flexibility is required to align seamlessly with Middle East working hours (Gulf Standard Time - GST / Eastern European Time - EET scales) to collaborate directly with teams across Dubai, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) is a leader in trusted enterprise conversational AI and digital transformation. The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

Position Overview

Welcome to the Agent, Admin and Supervisor Experience team at LivePerson! We are a team of 9 engineers located across 4 countries in Israel, Germany, India and Bulgaria.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our frontend architecture while contributing to our full-stack ecosystem. You will work in a fast-paced environment on projects spanning different company areas, aiming to enhance, scale, and simplify how brands engage with their customers through messaging.

We are looking for an individual who wants to do more than just manage, but also shape and innovate!

  • Lead AI-driven engineering practices. Champion the adoption of AI across the engineering organization by defining best practices, evaluating emerging AI-powered development tools, and establishing workflows that improve developer productivity, code quality, and architectural decision-making.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • A strong sense of quality, personal responsibility, and an unwavering passion for continuous improvement in software development.

Financial Security & Growth

  • Equipment: Internet and Mobile reimbursement
  • Development: Access to internal professional development resources.

‍‍‍ Time Away & Family Support

Volunteering Days: Use them to make a difference in your community. Whether it's a cleanup, supporting a local initiative or holding an “Ehrenamt”, just let us know! We're here to help you create a meaningful impact.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

As leaders in enterprise customer conversations, we celebrate diversity, empowering our team to forge impactful conversations globally. LivePerson is a place where uniqueness is embraced, growth is constant, and everyone is empowered to create their own success. We're very proud to have earned recognition from Fast Company, Newsweek, and BuiltIn for being a top innovative, beloved, and remote-friendly workplace, and recognized by Gartner as a leader in the Conversational AI space.

Belonging at LivePerson: Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by US Federal, State, or Local law.

Accessibility Commitment

LivePerson is dedicated to the accessibility needs of our applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should inform their recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Important Candidate Notice

The talent acquisition team at LivePerson has recently been notified of a phishing scam targeting candidates applying for our open roles. Scammers have been posing as hiring managers and recruiters in an effort to access candidates' personal and financial information. The phishing scam is not isolated to only LivePerson and has been documented in news articles and media outlets.

Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)

As a Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems.

You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV).

jobs.description:
Werkstudent:in für digitale Belegprüfung (w/m/d)

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis – digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst.

Der Unterschied zu anderen „Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen – und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du prüfst die Belege und Buchungsdaten unserer Mandanten, klärst Unstimmigkeiten direkt mit ihnen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Steuer-Team auf einer sauberen Datenbasis arbeitet.

Dazu arbeitest du Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.

Eine steuerfachliche Vorbildung oder eine bestimmte Studienrichtung brauchst du dafür nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Du bist die Kontrollinstanz zwischen Daten und Automatisierung

  • Unsere KI liest Belege aus, ordnet sie Bankumsätzen zu und schlägt die Verarbeitung vor. Du prüfst diese Vorschläge: Rechnungsangaben, Steuerausweis, Zeitraum, Zuordnung zum Mandanten.

  • Du bestätigst, korrigierst oder verwirfst.

  • Du erkennst, wo die Erkennung systematisch danebenliegt: bestimmte Belegtypen, Lieferanten, Fremdwährungen, Formate.

  • Du behältst die Schnittstellen im Blick und meldest, wenn eine Anbindung ausfällt oder dieselben Umsätze zweimal liefert.

2. Du übernimmst, was die KI noch nicht kann

  • Unklare Zahlungspartner, widersprüchliche Zuordnungen, Sonderfälle ohne Vorlage – alles, was sich nicht automatisch auflöst, landet bei dir.

  • Du recherchierst den Sachverhalt und entscheidest ihn im Rahmen unserer Prüfkriterien; alles, was eine steuerliche Beurteilung erfordert, geht an einen Berufsträger.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Lösung so, dass sie beim nächsten Mal automatisierbar ist.

Je besser die Automatisierung wird, desto anspruchsvoller werden die Fälle, die bei dir landen. Die Rolle wird dadurch nicht kleiner, sondern fachlicher.

3. Du klärst mit den Mandanten

  • Du forderst fehlende Belege an – schriftlich, konkret und mit Frist (nach kurzer Einarbeitung eigenständig) – und verfolgst offene Punkte bis zur Erledigung nach, damit die BWA bis zum 15. steht.

  • Du erklärst verständlich, warum ein Beleg nicht ausreicht und was du stattdessen brauchst.

4. Du machst die KI besser

  • Aus deinen Korrekturen und den Mustern, die du erkennst, werden Regeln, Prompts und Modellanpassungen – die entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

  • Du testest, was gebaut wurde, an echten Fällen und entscheidest mit, was als Nächstes automatisiert wird.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule – die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig. Mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche, idealerweise für mindestens 12 Monate.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du erkennst Muster und Abweichungen in Daten, ziehst aus Einzelfällen die richtigen Schlüsse und kannst begründen, warum etwas nicht stimmt.

  • Verlässliche Qualität bei hoher Fallzahl: Du arbeitest gründlich, auch wenn die KI in den meisten Fällen richtig liegt – gerade dann fallen die Ausnahmen leicht durchs Raster.

  • Interesse an KI und Automatisierung: Du willst verstehen, warum ein System etwas vorschlägt, und nicht nur, was es vorschlägt.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Google Sheets und digitalen Tools; Lust, dich in neue Software schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Klare, freundliche schriftliche Kommunikation auf Deutsch (C1/C2) – der Mandantenkontakt läuft überwiegend schriftlich.

  • Eigenständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Remote-Arbeit funktioniert nur, wenn Zusagen halten.

  • Interesse, langfristig bei uns zu bleiben und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Nice-to-have

  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie ein Geschäftsvorfall von der Rechnung bis zur Zahlung läuft.

  • Erste Berührung mit Buchhaltung, Rechnungswesen, DATEV oder kaufmännischer Sachbearbeitung – aus Praktikum, Nebenjob oder Studium.

  • Erfahrung aus einem Umfeld mit hohem Datenvolumen (Operations, Backoffice, Support, Fulfillment, Payment).

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools oder einfacher Automatisierung: Prompts, Formeln, Filter, kleine Skripte.

Kanzleierfahrung und Programmierkenntnisse erwarten wir nicht.

Was wir bieten

🚀 Deine Verbesserungsvorschläge werden gebaut – nicht abgeheftet. Unser Anspruch: Ein klar beschriebener, umsetzbarer Vorschlag ist innerhalb von acht Arbeitsstunden live. Das geht, weil Engineering, Design und Fachteam bei uns am selben Tisch sitzen.

🤖 Du arbeitest an der Grenze dessen, was Automatisierung in der Steuerberatung kann – und verschiebst sie. Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen, moderne Hardware.

📚 Studienfreundliche Planung. Arbeitszeiten rund um Vorlesungen und Klausurphasen – reduzierte Wochen in der Prüfungszeit sind normal, nicht die Ausnahme.

🎯 Ein benannter Weg nach dem Studium. Übernahme, danach Teamlead oder Onboarding Specialist – mit Kriterien, die wir gemeinsam festhalten.

🏡 Vollständig remote möglich. Büro in München im Herzen der Stadt, wenn du willst – Pflicht ist es nicht.

🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team. Kurze Wege, direktes Sparring – keine Kaffeeküchen-Praktikantenrolle.

Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

Sales Director, Raconteur

Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below. 

The opportunity

Raconteur, part of TechnologyAdvice, is seeking a Sales Director to lead, develop, and raise the performance of our commercial sales team while owning a defined, high-value territory of their own.

This is an intentionally hands-on leadership role for an exceptional commercial operator who wants the responsibility of leading others without stepping away from the market.

You will carry two clear accountabilities.

  • Deliver exceptional commercial performance from your own territory.
  • Create the leadership, standards, coaching and accountability that enable your team to consistently deliver theirs.

Success requires both.

You will lead from the front, personally developing senior client relationships, creating opportunities, shaping ambitious commercial solutions and closing meaningful business. At the same time, you will coach sellers through complex opportunities, strengthen territory and account strategy, improve pipeline quality, raise forecasting accuracy, develop talent and create a culture where ambition is matched by execution.

Raconteur helps ambitious B2B brands influence senior decision makers and create measurable commercial impact through branded content, thought leadership, proprietary research, digital experiences, events, roundtables, audience engagement and demand generation.

Our proposition allows clients to connect brand, engagement and demand through integrated programmes designed around their objectives rather than individual products.

Our special interest reports published in The Times provide an additional highly distinctive platform for clients seeking to influence senior business audiences through premium editorial environments.

The Sales Director will ensure our commercial team brings the full strength of this proposition into the market. You will help move client conversations beyond individual products, uncover bigger commercial challenges and create integrated solutions that are more valuable to clients and more difficult for competitors to replicate

You will work closely with senior commercial leadership to translate ambitious revenue goals into clear priorities, territory strategies and action.

You will have meaningful autonomy over how your team operates, direct accountability for measurable commercial outcomes and the opportunity to influence how Raconteur builds its next generation of sales talent and leadership. For a high-performing individual contributor ready to prove they can succeed through others, or an existing sales leader ready for greater commercial ownership, visibility and responsibility, this represents a significant career opportunity.

Location: United Kingdom

 

What you'll do

  • Own both a personal revenue target and accountability for the commercial performance of your sales team.
  • Lead from the front, actively developing your own territory, building senior client relationships, creating opportunities and leading complex sales cycles through to close.
  • Translate revenue goals into clear territory priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations, activity standards and measurable outcomes across the team.
  • Build a high-performance culture where expectations are clear, accountability is consistent, and every seller understands what excellent performance looks like and how to achieve it.
  • Coach and develop sellers through one-to-ones, call coaching, deal strategy, pipeline reviews and account planning, strengthening discovery, value selling, prospecting, stakeholder management, negotiation and closing capability.
  • Ensure the team sells around client objectives rather than individual products, creating integrated solutions across branded content, research, digital experiences, events, roundtables, audience engagement, demand generation and special interest reports.
  • Bring rigour to pipeline management and forecasting by challenging assumptions, testing deal quality, identifying risk early and maintaining a clear view of where future revenue will come from.
  • Drive both new business and account growth, ensuring sellers proactively create opportunities, engage senior decision makers and develop client relationships into broader, more valuable partnerships.
  • Personally support strategically important or complex opportunities where your experience and seniority can materially improve the likelihood or value of success.
  • Use revenue, conversion, pipeline and market data to identify performance gaps and determine whether intervention is required across activity, capability, strategy or prioritisation.
  • Maintain strong sales process, CRM and opportunity management discipline across the team.
  • Partner closely with Commercial Content, Editorial, Marketing, Client Success and Operations to ensure solutions are compelling, achievable and aligned with the customer experience we promise.
  • Recruit and onboard exceptional commercial talent, building the market knowledge, proposition understanding and selling capability required to become productive quickly.
  • Develop high potential team members into future senior sellers and sales leaders, while addressing underperformance early through clear expectations, targeted coaching and measurable improvement plans.
  • Continuously raise the commercial standard of the team, turning successful behaviours, approaches and learnings into repeatable ways of working that improve performance at scale.

What success looks like

Success will be measured through two lenses: the commercial results you personally deliver and the performance you create through others.

You will be successful when:

  • You consistently achieve your personal revenue target, and the team delivers against its collective revenue goals.
  • Your territory and the wider team maintain a healthy, credible pipeline with disciplined qualification and accurate forecasting.
  • The team creates more net new opportunities, increases opportunity quality and value, and builds deeper relationships with senior decision makers.
  • Existing client relationships grow through proactive account development and stronger integrated solutions.
  • Sellers demonstrably improve their discovery, commercial thinking, account planning, objection handling, negotiation and closing capability through your coaching.
  • Performance standards are clear and consistently managed, with high performers challenged and developed and underperformance addressed early.
  • New hires become productive quickly, and high potential talent progresses into future senior sellers and sales leaders.
  • Clients and cross-functional teams trust the commercial organisation because what is sold, promised and delivered remains aligned.
  • Senior leadership has confidence in your forecast, commercial judgement and ability to identify risks and opportunities early.
  • The commercial team becomes stronger, more capable and more consistently successful because of your leadership.

Who you are

  • An accomplished B2B media, publishing or marketing solutions salesperson with a consistent record of delivering ambitious revenue targets and winning complex, high-value opportunities with senior marketing decision-makers.
  • Significant experience carrying a personal quota, combined with the drive to create pipeline, engage clients and close meaningful business.
  • Leadership or player-coach experience, or compelling evidence of readiness to take accountability for the performance and development of others.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate business through intelligent prospecting, territory strategy and account development, while leading sophisticated sales cycles from discovery and proposal development through negotiation and close.
  • A strong understanding of how B2B marketers approach brand, content, thought leadership, research, audience engagement, events and demand generation, with the ability to connect these capabilities into integrated solutions built around client outcomes.
  • Commercial curiosity and the ability to move conversations beyond the initial brief to uncover the underlying objective, challenge, urgency and opportunity.
  • Strong judgment around pipeline and deal quality, including the ability to distinguish activity from progress, interest from intent and attractive opportunities from genuinely qualified business.
  • A credible coaching style grounded in diagnosing performance gaps, providing clear, actionable feedback and adapting the approach to different individuals while maintaining consistently high standards.
  • A track record of developing high performers without overmanaging them and addressing underperformance directly, constructively and without avoiding difficult conversations.
  • Demonstrated ability to create clarity, set expectations and build accountability while providing the coaching and support people need to succeed.
  • Sound judgment about when direct involvement will improve an opportunity and when coaching someone else is the best path to winning it.
  • Clear, confident communication, sound commercial decision-making and the credibility to represent Raconteur with senior clients, executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Resilience, competitiveness, curiosity and a high level of accountability, paired with the ambition to develop people, raise standards, influence commercial strategy and be measured by more than an individual revenue number.

What we offer you

  • Career Growth: Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives.
  • Flex Fridays: Adjust your 40-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays.
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Private Health & Dental Insurance: Comprehensive coverage, including discounted gym memberships and additional perks.
  • Paid Time Off: Start with 25 days of holiday per year, with an additional day added for each year of service.
  • Parental Leave: Supportive maternity and paternity leave policies.
  • Salary Sacrifice Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs with our tax-efficient program.
  • Life Assurance: Peace of mind with coverage to protect your loved ones.
  • Pension Plan: Invest in your future with our competitive pension scheme.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Access free counseling and other support services.
  • Wellness Perks: Access the Headspace app to support your well-being.
  • Speaker Series Bonus: Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
jobs.description:
Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (Este)
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager (Este)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Eeste), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.

We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.

You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal. As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

What your day could look like

  • Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.

  • Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

  • Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.

  • Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.

  • Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.

  • Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.

  • Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.

  • Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.

  • Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.

  • Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

Who are we looking for

  • A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.

  • Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.

  • Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.

  • Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.

  • Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.

  • A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.

  • Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

  • Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.

  • Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.

  • A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.

Halter in Argentina

Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"
