Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for an Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition based in Switzerland who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across Switzerland and Austria. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Previous experience selling to companies based in Switzerland and/or Austria
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & German (both written and spoken)

Bonus Points For:

  • French language skills
  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards

In Switzerland, the OTE compensation range for this role is CHF 170,000 - CHF 210,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager:in (all genders) für Paid Ads, Creatives und KI
jobs.description:
Performance Marketing Manager:in (all genders) für Paid Ads, Creatives und KI

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Unser Wachstum hängt an zwei Seiten gleichzeitig. Wer etwas verschicken will, braucht jemanden, der es mitnimmt. Wer mitnehmen will, braucht Aufträge auf seiner Strecke. Ein Download ist dabei erst der Anfang. Entscheidend ist, ob am Ende ein Transport stattfindet und die Person wiederkommt.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du verantwortest Paid-Kanäle und denkst den ganzen Funnel mit, vom ersten Kontakt mit einer Ad bis zum abgeschlossenen Transport. Zum Start arbeitet dich unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager in alle unsere Tools und Workflows ein, die bei uns KI-first aufgebaut sind.

Du bist nicht die Person, die nur Kosten pro Install drückt. Du willst verstehen, warum Nutzer:innen kommen, wo sie abspringen und welcher Hebel wirklich wirkt. Und du nutzt KI jeden Tag, um schneller zu testen, auszuwerten und zu bauen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.11. in Vollzeit als Verstärkung für unser Growth-Team in Hamburg 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Paid-Kanäle verantworten

Du steuerst unsere Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads und TikTok. Planung, Setup, Budget, tägliche Optimierung. Du entscheidest mit, wo der nächste Euro am meisten bringt.

  • Den ganzen Funnel im Blick

Download, Registrierung, erstes Transportgesuch, Match, abgeschlossener Transport, Wiederkehr. Du optimierst auf die Schritte, die für uns wirklich zählen. Mit Tech sorgst du dafür, dass diese Events sauber gemessen und an die Plattformen zurückgespielt werden.

  • Zwei Seiten, eine Strategie

Wir brauchen Versender:innen und Fahrer:innen, am besten auf denselben Strecken. Du erkennst, wo eine Seite fehlt, und steuerst Kampagnen nach Stadt, Strecke und Kategorie gezielt dagegen.

  • Creative-Pipeline

Du baust eine Pipeline auf, die unsere Ads dauerhaft frisch hält. Briefings, Hooks, UGC, KI-Varianten, Abstimmung mit Design und Content. Du weißt, welches Creative warum funktioniert.

  • Testing-Programm

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)

Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity


Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today

alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants.

The role

You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy.

That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning.

It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier.

What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe.

What you'll do

  • Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use
  • Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction
  • Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning
  • Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language
  • Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical
  • Collaborate with the product team on backend work

Requirements

You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count.

Must-haves

  • You've deployed production-grade Python applications
  • You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles
  • You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams
  • You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early
  • You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects
  • Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django
  • PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases
  • Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems


Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you.


How we work

You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy.

Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving.

We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests.

We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here.

Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert or management tracks - and the chance to lead a product area within a couple of years.

Benefits

    • 25 days' vacation - plus an extra day for every 2 years here, and the days between Christmas and New Year off
    • €1,500/year and 3 days/quarter for your own development
    • The Mac of your choice
    • An office in the heart of Berlin Mitte


Our Tech Stack

    • Backend & data: Python throughout - FastAPI (auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI), SQLAlchemy, pydantic, pytest, mypy; pandas, polars, numpy, sklearn; uv for dependencies
    • Infra: PostgreSQL, AWS on Kubernetes managed with Terraform, ArgoWorkflows for scheduled jobs, GitLab for code
    • Frontend: React & Next.js in TypeScript with TailwindCSS; Blueprint.js / Radix UI; TanStack Query or axios; Streamlit for internal tools


Our Hiring Process is fully remote

    1. Intro call with our Recruiter
    2. Meet our Hiring Manager
    3. A take-home task that mirrors the real work you'd be doing
    4. Technical interview (90 min) with two engineers, including 30 min of live coding
    5. Team-fit interview (45 min) with two future teammates


At alcemy, we're building a team as diverse as the industry we're transforming. We welcome applications from everyone and assess every candidate on merit alone - regardless of gender, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or worldview, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We especially encourage people who are underrepresented in tech to apply. If you need any adjustments to take part fully in our hiring process, just let us know and we'll make them.


Note: We don't currently offer visa sponsorship, so you'll need a valid EU work visa.

Create the Future of Travel With Us

Whether it's visiting the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is essential.

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. One way is through partnerships with third-parties who refer their SME clients to Allica on an ongoing basis based on mutual trust. Our Partnerships Team work with trusted advisors to established SMEs, in particular their Accountants.

As a Partnerships Manager, you will develop and nurture relationships with accounting firms across your region, taking a consultative, B2B sales approach. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

Principal Accountabilities

• Manage a regional portfolio of accounting firms- covering cold outbound, warm inbound, and active introducers- moving each firm through the pipeline to become a repeat client introducer.

• Grow Allica’s presence across each firm, including multiple stakeholders, colleagues and offices, through regular regional travel and in-person meetings.

• Qualify and introduce clients with lending needs (e.g. commercial mortgages) to the appropriate Relationship Manager.

Security Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Security Engineer Intern

About the role

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do

Detection and response

  • Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.
  • Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.
  • Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits

  • Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.
  • Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own

  • Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.
  • Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud

  • Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

  • You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.
  • You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.
  • You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.
  • You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.
  • You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.
  • You have some scripting ability (Python or equivalent) and a basic understanding of web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

Nice to have that would make you stand out

  • Personal projects, CTFs, homelab, bug bounty or security writeups.
  • First exposure to a SIEM, to detection rules or to log analysis at scale.
  • Curiosity for fraud and abuse patterns in a financial product.

What this internship is not

  • Not a pure GRC, compliance or policy writing internship.
  • Not a pentest internship.
  • Not a role where you watch dashboards without changing them.

Practical details

  • Location: Paris preferred.
  • Duration and start date: 3-6 months internship, ASAP or from January 2027
  • Mentor: a Security Engineer from the team.

jobs.description:
Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. Tech Stack

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Solution Architect - LangGraph & Agentic AI

We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI solutions to lead the architecture of enterprise agentic AI platforms and applications.

You will work with business and technology stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready architectures.

The role combines AI architecture, enterprise integration, cloud engineering, agentic AI, security, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

You will be expected to understand LangGraph at a practical level and be able to challenge architectural decisions, guide engineering teams, and ensure that AI solutions can operate reliably at enterprise scale.

Requirements

AI Solution Architecture

  • Lead the architecture and design of enterprise AI agent and agentic workflow solutions.
  • Design LangGraph-based architectures for single-agent and multi-agent applications.
  • Translate business requirements, processes, SLAs, security requirements, and technical constraints into solution architectures.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and document key technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for agentic AI solutions.

Enterprise Agent Architecture

  • Design architectures incorporating:
    • LLMs
    • LangGraph
    • RAG
    • Enterprise data
    • APIs and business systems
    • Workflow engines
    • Human approval processes
    • Observability
    • Security and governance
  • Define appropriate boundaries between AI reasoning and deterministic business logic.
  • Design state management, persistence, recovery, and long-running agent workflows.
  • Determine when to use single-agent, multi-agent, or conventional application architectures.

Cloud and Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable AI application architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Define compute, networking, storage, API, security, and platform requirements.
  • Design architectures suitable for enterprise-scale production workloads.
  • Evaluate cloud services and AI platform capabilities based on performance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Work with platform engineering and DevOps teams to establish deployment standards.

Integration Architecture

  • Design integration between AI agents and enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms.
  • Define secure mechanisms for agent tool access and business-system interactions.
  • Design authentication, authorisation, secrets management, and access-control approaches.
  • Ensure AI-driven actions are traceable, auditable, and appropriately governed.

AI Security and Governance

  • Establish security and governance principles for enterprise AI agents.
  • Address risks including:
    • Prompt injection
    • Data leakage
    • Unauthorised tool usage
    • Excessive agent permissions
    • Inaccurate or unsafe actions
    • Sensitive-data exposure
  • Define appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Ensure solutions comply with organisational security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible-AI requirements.

AI Evaluation and Observability

  • Define architecture for AI application monitoring and observability.
  • Establish approaches for evaluating agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Define appropriate logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting.
  • Establish operational processes for monitoring and continuously improving production agents.

Stakeholder and Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders to define AI strategies and roadmaps.
  • Lead architecture workshops and technical design sessions.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide technical direction to AI engineers, developers, data teams, and platform engineers.
  • Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Mentor engineering teams and promote reusable AI architecture patterns.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in solution architecture, software architecture, AI architecture, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI applications or agentic workflows.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application architectures.
  • Experience with enterprise AI/ML solutions in production.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and APIs.
  • Experience with security, governance, observability, and operational requirements for production systems.
  • Strong technical understanding of Python and modern software engineering practices.

  • Microservices
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • CI/CD

DPO & Compliance Officer

🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

  • Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

  • Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

  • Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

  • Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

  • Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

  • Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

  • For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

  • For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

  • Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

  • Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

  • Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

  • Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

  • Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

  • Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

  • Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

  • Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)

At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.
  • Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.
  • Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.
  • Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.
  • Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.
  • Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.
  • Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.
  • Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation.
  • Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.
  • Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.

Nice to have

  • Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.
  • Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.
  • Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.
  • SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.

Benefits

  • Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.
  • Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.
  • Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.
  • Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.
  • An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.
  • Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.
  • Personally own and close strategic opportunities while the regional team is being built out, transitioning toward a team-quota model as the organization scales.
  • Develop and execute go-to-market strategy across both SIMPL verticals: urban intersection management and inter-urban highway/tunnel/tolling detection.
  • Manage and grow relationships with European distributors, system integrators, and OEM partners, alongside direct engagement with end-user agencies and pilot customers.

  • Represent SIMPL at European trade shows, industry events, and customer meetings.
  • Partner with SIMPL's European engineering team on technical qualification and solution scoping for major opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Head of Global ITS Business and BU leadership on regional pricing, deal structuring, and strategic account planning.
  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Compensation

jobs.title: Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d)
Westbridge-Gruppe | Was uns antreibt

Gebäude müssen heute mehr leisten als je zuvor: effizienter werden, Ressourcen schonen und gleichzeitig wirtschaftlich betrieben werden. Dafür braucht es Transparenz, messbare Daten und intelligente Lösungen.
 
Als einer der führenden Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsberater für die Immobilienwirtschaft in Europa treiben wir diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, Gebäude und Portfolios fit für die Zukunft zu machen – von der ersten strategischen Idee über die technische Planung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
 
Um diesen Weg weiterzugehen und gemeinsam mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden die Energieversorgung von morgen zu gestalten, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Associate Director Sustainability Sales (m/w/d) für unser Team an den Standorten Hamburg oder Frankfurt.


Deine Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle übernimmst du Verantwortung und arbeitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team an Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem: 

  • Du verantwortest die strategische Gewinnung und Entwicklung von Kunden für unsere Nachhaltigkeitslösungen innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft.
  • Du identifizierst eigenverantwortlich neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und nutzt Dein bestehendes Netzwerk, um relevante Entscheidungsträger für Westbridge zu gewinnen.
  • Du vertrittst Westbridge auf Messen, Konferenzen und Branchenveranstaltungen und positionierst uns als führenden Partner für Nachhaltigkeit in der Immobilienwirtschaft.
  • Du analysierst die strategischen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Sustainability-Expertinnen und -Experten individuelle Lösungsansätze.
  • Du steuerst komplexe Vertriebsprozesse vom Erstkontakt über die Präsentation und Angebotserstellung bis zur Verhandlung und zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, verantwortest Deine Sales Pipeline und leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zu unseren Wachstums- und Umsatzzielen.


Das bringst du mit

Fachliche Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sind für uns genauso wichtig wie deine Freude an Zusammenarbeit und daran, gemeinsam gute Lösungen zu entwickeln. Dabei ist uns besonders wichtig:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – idealerweise mit Bezug zur Immobilienwirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeit oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Mindestens sechs Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Immobilienwirtschaft, Nachhaltigkeitsberatung oder im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Beratungs- und Dienstleistungen.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse rund um die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien, beispielsweise in den Bereichen ESG, Dekarbonisierung, Energieeffizienz oder nachhaltiges Immobilienmanagement.
  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb der Immobilienwirtschaft sowie nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung.
  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Verhandlungs- und Abschlussstärke sowie ein souveränes Auftreten auf Management- und Entscheider Ebene.
  • Eine selbstständige, unternehmerische und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


So arbeiten wir

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst dich aktiv einbringen. Gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus unterschiedlichen Fachrichtungen entwickelst du Lösungen für komplexe Fragestellungen und hast die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. 
 
Damit dies gelingt, bieten wir dir die entsprechenden Rahmenbedingungen: ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, 30 Urlaubstage, freie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester, betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie Benefits wie Deutschlandticket, Edenred City oder Urban Sports Club, Firmenrad-Leasing und weitere Extras.


Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mit dir darüber zu sprechen, wie dein nächster beruflicher Schritt aussehen soll – und ob wir der richtige Partner dafür sind.

jobs.title: Director Institutional Capital and Partnerships (m/w/d) – Frankfurt, Hamburg und Berlin
jobs.description:
Director Institutional Capital and Partnerships (m/w/d) – Frankfurt, Hamburg und Berlin
Tätigkeitsbereich

Du verantwortest die Akquise institutioneller Kunden und Mandate mit Schwerpunkt Brown-to-Green im Bereich Residential. Dies beinhaltet Partnerschaften und Asset Management Mandate für die Transformation bestehender Portfolios, als auch Einwerbung institutionellen Eigenkapitals für unsere Immobilienstrategien – von Club Deals und Separate Accounts über Joint Ventures bis hin zu Fondsvehikeln. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für Investoren, führst Gespräche eigenständig bis zum Abschluss und baust die Partner- und Kapitalseite unserer Plattform systematisch aus.


Dabei handelt es sich um keine reine Vertriebsrolle. Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Transaktion, Asset Management und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und übersetzt zwischen den Erwartungen der Investoren und operativer Realität.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Versorgungswerken, Pensionskassen, Versicherungen, Sparkassen, Stiftungen, Family Offices und Dachfonds

  • Eigenständige Ansprache, Qualifizierung und Betreuung von Investoren über den gesamten Zyklus – vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Investorenunterlagen: Teaser, Pitch Decks, Track-Record-Darstellungen, Investment Memoranda

  • Steuerung von Due-Diligence-Prozessen auf Investorenseite, inklusive Koordination von RfPs, DDQs und Datenraumanfragen

  • Verhandlung kommerzieller Eckpunkte (Fee-Strukturen, Co-Investment, Governance, Reporting-Anforderungen) in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Kontinuierliche Marktbeobachtung hinsichtlich: Allokationsverhalten, Wettbewerbsvehikel sowie regulatorische Entwicklungen (Solvency II, AnlV, KAGB)

  • Pflege der Investoren-Pipeline im CRM, belastbares Reporting an die Geschäftsführung

  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens auf Branchenveranstaltungen (Expo Real, MIPIM, Fachkonferenzen)


Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5–8 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Capital Raising, Investor Relations oder im institutionellen Vertrieb – zwingend mit klarem Immobilienbezug 

  • Belastbares, aktives Netzwerk zu deutschen institutionellen Investoren sowie nachweisbare eigene Abschlüsse

  • Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Immobilien-Kennzahlen und Strukturen (u.a IRR, Equity Multiple, Cash-on-Cash, Wasserfall, Leverage, Asset-Deal vs. Share-Deal) 

  • Fundierte Kenntnis der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen deutscher institutioneller Anleger 

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 

  • Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands

  • Wünschenswert: 

    • Erfahrung mit Value-Add- oder opportunistischen Strategien, nicht nur Core wäre wünschenswert

    • Vorerfahrung auf Investorenseite (z. B. Kapitalanlage, Immobilienreferate)

    • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen LPs oder Luxemburger Strukturen

    • Bestehende Beziehungen zu Platzierungsberatern und Consultants


Unsere Benefits, wir schaffen

  • Raum für Erholung: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Der 24. und 31. Dezember sind zusätzlich arbeitsfrei. Für besondere Ereignisse (wie Umzug) bekommst du weiteren Sonderurlaub.
  • Raum für Mobilität: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket und unterstützen dein JobRad, so kommst du nachhaltig und flexibel zur Arbeit.
  • Raum für Absicherung: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sorgen wir dafür, dass du langfristig gut abgesichert in die Zukunft blickst.
  • Raum für Ideen: Deine Meinung zählt! Wir fördern kreative Impulse und laden dich ein, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Reneo mitzuwirken.
  • Raum für Gesundheit & Lifestyle: Du hast die Wahl zwischen unseren Sportangeboten (z. B. Urban Sports Club) oder erhältst Lunch-Gutscheine für deine Mittagspause.

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
  • Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on. Surface dependencies early, clear blockers, and make the trade-off calls with Product and the founders.
  • We expect engineering to care about business and product and we expect you to be an example here
  • Set the architecture so it holds as data volume, customer count and the team grow.
  • Run incidents properly: fast response, honest postmortems, fixes that stop the same thing happening again
  • Keep enough processes to be reliable and no more. A 11-person team should not feel like a 100-person one
  • Work closely with Product, Data Science, our energy market experts and other disciplines, so we build against the real physical and regulatory constraints


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have

  • 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams before in a product company, including senior engineers or squad leads
  • You have done it in a lean team, hands-on, without a layer of managers to delegate to. Some excellent large-company leaders struggle here. There is no layer to hide behind
  • You have personally owned delivery predictability and reliability for a production system real customers depend on, and you can tell us what it looked like before and after
  • Strong technical judgment in at least two of: cloud and distributed backend / multi-tenant SaaS; high-volume or time-series data pipelines; IoT, device integration and real-time telemetry; ML or optimization in production. Deep enough to earn engineers' trust, make architecture calls and set the technical direction yourself
  • You have run hiring and performance for real: you have grown people, and you have also managed people out when that was the right call
  • You treat incident management, security and compliance as yours to own, not to delegate
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a strong plus — most of our customers are German Mittelstand
Nice to have
  • Energy, industrial, SaaS or a physical-world domain.
  • Having been the most senior technical person somewhere before (CTO, VP Engineering, or the person everyone asked).
Not required
  • Being the strongest coder on the team. You do need to read the code, make architecture calls, and occasionally build something.
  • A “Head of” title already. We look at what you have done, not what it was called.


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

jobs.description:
Product Marketing Lead, Billing

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we're a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It's faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We're backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role

This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and owns product marketing for the Billing product group. You will work across Product, Growth, Revenue Marketing, Sales, Finance, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and Brand to turn customer insight into a clear story, a strong go-to-market plan, and measurable market impact.

Monetisation becomes harder as software businesses grow. Pricing models, subscriptions, payments, invoicing, and revenue operations can become a patchwork that slows launches, creates risk, and pulls teams away from their customers.

You will turn a complex commercial problem into a clear story for the people who buy, build, operate, and grow software businesses. You will own the product-area narrative and execution, while partnering with cross-functional teams on broader company positioning, category strategy, and major commercial decisions.

What you'll do

  • Build customer and market insight through research, customer conversations, usage signals, competitive intelligence, and commercial feedback.

  • Define positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, and the product story for your product group.

  • Lead high-impact launches, commercial initiatives, and change programs from early strategy through readiness, channel activation, adoption, advocacy, and learning.

  • Build focused go-to-market plans across the channels that matter, with clear audiences, owners, trade-offs, and measures.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Support early enough to influence priorities, packaging, enablement, and customer outcomes.

  • Equip Revenue Marketing, Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Support, and partners with clear stories, talk tracks, proof, and practical guidance.

  • Bring competitive and market insight into product, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market decisions, and identify opportunities to sharpen differentiation.

  • Set objectives and measures for customer adoption, retention, and commercial impact. Make practical recommendations using data and opportunity sizing to highlight the business and customer opportunity.

  • Use AI to improve research, synthesis, analysis, competitive intelligence, workflow automation, and product marketing quality, with strong judgement and verification.

We'd love to hear from you if you are

  • A track record of bringing complex B2B, fintech, payments, billing, infrastructure, or platform products to market.

  • Experience leading high-impact launches, migrations, packaging changes, or commercial initiative with measurable results.

  • Strong customer discovery, segmentation, positioning, storytelling, and commercial judgement.

  • The ability to connect product detail to outcomes such as growth, retention, efficiency, flexibility, and confidence.

  • Comfort working with technical, product, finance, operations, sales, solutions, support, and executive audiences.

  • Range across launches, enablement, adoption, change management, measurement, competitive insight, and customer advocacy.

  • Examples of using AI, agents, or automation to improve speed, quality, or insight.


What good looks like
Within your first year, the Billing team has a sharper product story, a repeatable approach to launches and commercial change, stronger enablement, and a clear view of what is driving customer adoption and business impact. Product and go-to-market partners trust you to bring clarity, make smart trade-offs, and turn insight into action.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle
At Paddle, we're committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don't care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you're from. We're more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you'll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don't match every part of the job ad, especially if you're part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there's anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We're committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let's grow together.

Our Values

Paddle Together - "None of us, is as smart as all of us"

Paddle Simply - "Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple"

Paddle for others - "We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs"

Why you'll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a 'digital-first' company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. Director of Sales, ITS, Europe

Who is Seyond? 

 
Seyond is a leading global provider of image-grade LiDAR technology, powering a safer, smarter and more mobile world across the automotive, intelligent transportation, robotics and industrial automation sectors. Founded in Silicon Valley with strategically placed research and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Seyond is crafting LiDAR solutions that elevate autonomous driving and fuel the advancement of smart infrastructure development. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Currently, over 200,000 Falcon units are in use, and the product continues to be mass-produced today. 

 

Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. We need someone who has personally carried and exceeded a sales quota — not a candidate whose background is purely sales operations or account management — and who can also recruit, coach, and manage a small, distributed team of regional reps as the European organization scales.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.

  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

You will be an integral part of an established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become. 

In this exciting role, your initial focus will be on Castle Busters, a game that has already demonstrated significant promise with its compelling core mechanics and engaging gameplay. You'll have the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth and refinement of the game, to continue building a truly exceptional player experience. This is a unique chance to join a project with established momentum while still having a significant impact on its future direction within a dedicated and agile studio environment.

Role

We’re seeking a talented Producer who is deeply passionate about games and laser-focused on creating the next big hit. You'll play a pivotal role in delivering fun to millions of players. As one of the driving force behind the game's success, you'll ensure the game reaches the highest standards of quality and innovation.

  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks

With this role, you will have a strong impact on the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a senior, multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people working on one of the most ambitious Voodoo game. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with our game!

Profile
